needs_review.finding: https://cadence.org/missionary/ben-and-doris-hyde/ is titled 'Doris Hyde - Cadence International' in search results, though the slug names Ben and Doris.
needs_review.evidence: Search result title 'Doris Hyde - Cadence International' at URL /missionary/ben-and-doris-hyde/; a snippet on the same page references 'Ben (from Annapolis, MD) and Doris (Spencerville, OH)' in past tense about how they met.
needs_review.recommendation: Emitted Doris only. Do NOT add Ben Hyde without a fetch of the live page — this is the exact pattern where an agency keeps a couple URL after one spouse has died or left. Verify before any outreach.

needs_review.issue: Published first name is an initialism
needs_review.evidence: Slug and title both read 'bb'/'BB'. Surname is fully published and the posting is a US base (Joint Base Langley-Eustis, VA), so this is not sensitive-region anonymization.
needs_review.recommendation: Emitted as-is. Treat 'BB' as the name Cadence publishes; do not expand or guess a longer given name.

needs_review.issue: Slug short forms vs title full names
needs_review.evidence: Slug uses 'ken-christi'; the result title gives 'Kenneth & Christina'.
needs_review.recommendation: Emitted using the title's full first names with the shared surname from the slug. Flagged so the orchestrator does not read the slug/name mismatch as a bad citation.

needs_review.issue: Out-of-slice people surfaced by exclusion sweeps
needs_review.finding: Several records emitted here are posted outside the eastern-US slice (e.g. Ellsworth AFB, Luke AFB, Travis AFB, Fort Carson, Fort Irwin, Kitsap, Okinawa, Korea, Germany, Spain, Hawaii, Alaska).
needs_review.evidence: Exclusion sweeps on this domain return roster-wide results rather than geography-filtered ones.
needs_review.recommendation: Emitted per the brief's 'if you find a person, emit them' rule. Expect heavy overlap with cad-europe, cad-pacific, cad-us-west and cad-role; dedupe on source_url plus full name, NEVER on surname (two unrelated Sprague households exist on this domain).

needs_review.issue: Eastern bases with no Cadence presence found
needs_review.finding: No /missionary/ page surfaced for Quantico, Fort Belvoir, Fort Drum, West Point, Aberdeen, Dover, Parris Island, Charleston, Fort Campbell, Fort Knox, Eglin, Mayport, or the Naval Academy as a posting (Stan Fisher is at Annapolis but as active-duty faculty).
needs_review.evidence: Query 8 ('Wright-Patterson' OR 'Dover' OR 'Langley' OR 'Parris Island' OR 'Charleston') returned zero cadence.org results; Wright-Patterson and Langley were later found only via exclusion sweeps, which suggests those base names are not indexed as page text.
needs_review.recommendation: Base-name queries are weaker on this domain than exclusion sweeps. A future wave should spend its whole budget on exclusion sweeps rather than on geography.
